verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform with APIs and services, so documented rate limits and concurrency caps are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents API rate limits or concurrency caps. Replica scaling, adjustable resource limits and hard spending limits are adjacent controls, not documented rate or concurrency limits, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented rate limits and concurrency caps for APIs and functions so I can plan for scale
